tools.name: Search PDB
tools.description: Search the RCSB Protein Data Bank using attribute-based, sequence similarity, structure similarity, or full-text queries.

query.description: PDB search query in RCSB Search API JSON format.

return_type.description: Type of results to return: entry, polymer_entity, assembly, mol_definition.

rows.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: Fetch PDB Metadata
tools.description: Query PDB metadata using GraphQL. Efficiently retrieves titles, resolution, organism, citations, and more without downloading full coordinate files.

graphql_query.description: GraphQL query string for the RCSB Data API.

tools.name: Download PDB Structure
tools.description: Download coordinate files (mmCIF or PDB format) for specified PDB entries.

pdb_ids.description: List of PDB IDs to download.

tools.name: Fetch PDB Schema
tools.description: Retrieve the searchable attribute schema for PDB search or data APIs.

tools.name: Fetch AlphaFold Structure
tools.description: Download AlphaFold predicted structure (mmCIF), PAE matrix, and metadata for a UniProt accession.

tools.name: Analyze pLDDT Confidence
tools.description: Analyze per-residue pLDDT confidence scores from an AlphaFold prediction. Reports overall confidence, disordered regions, and structural assessment.

metadata_path.description: Path to the AlphaFold metadata JSON file.

tools.name: Analyze PAE Domains
tools.description: Analyze Predicted Aligned Error matrix to detect rigid domain boundaries and inter-domain flexibility.

pae_json_path.description: Path to the PAE JSON file.

tools.name: Render in Science Canvas
tools.description: Push a 3D molecular structure to the Science Canvas sidecar for interactive visualization.

identifier.description: PDB ID, UniProt ID, or file path.
